question: この要件から設計・実装へ進んでよいか。
description: Reviews requirements before design and implementation proceed from them. The judgment is about the requirement set itself — contradiction, terminology conflict, constraint conflict, feasibility, testability — and never about code that does not exist yet.
subject: requirements

baseline.description: A requirement set is judged as it stands rather than against an earlier revision, so this Flow declares no compare-baseline step.

evidence.description: The requirement set is the subject; without it the run stops with DETERMINISTIC_UNRUNNABLE.
Absent design skips the constraint-conflict cross-check and records the reason.
Absent plan skips the feasibility cross-check and records the reason.
Absent test evidence degrades the testability judgment to a requirements-only one rather than skipping it: that no test evidence exists is part of the answer, not a reason to stop asking.
